name: xAI API
description: Serves xAI's Grok models through an OpenAI-compatible Responses API with function calling, web search, voice, and image generation, for developers building on Grok.

skills.name: Responses API
skills.description: Generates text and multi-turn replies with Grok models, optionally keeping conversation state server-side.

skills.name: Function Calling
skills.description: Lets Grok request calls to custom tools you define with a JSON schema and run locally.

skills.name: Web Search
skills.description: Lets Grok search the web and browse pages in real time to answer with current information.

skills.name: Voice APIs
skills.description: Provides text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and real-time speech-to-speech over WebSockets.

skills.name: Image Generation
skills.description: Generates images from text prompts with Grok Imagine models, with aspect ratio and resolution control.
